title_zh: 选定奇幻小说并安排读书小组讨论

scenario.goal_zh: 比较故事题材与讨论安排后选定共读作品

context_zh: 两名读书小组成员比较虚构小说并确定下次共读作品。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Would the group prefer a realistic novel this month, or should we try a different genre?

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: I would like some fantasy. What is The Clockmaker's Island about?

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: A young genius invents a machine that can stop time, but an evil ruler wants to use it against the islanders.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Does the inventor become a famous hero?

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Not really. She gives up the chance of fame so that nobody else can copy the machine.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: That gives us something to discuss beyond who wins the final battle.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: The other book is another family drama. We have read three of those recently.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: Then let us choose The Clockmaker's Island. Can we discuss it on the last Thursday of the month?

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: Yes. I will ask everyone to read the whole book by then.

sentences.speaker: Oscar
sentences.text: I will prepare two questions about the inventor's final choice.
